# ClearCut — Free AI Background Remover

> ClearCut is a free online AI background remover that creates transparent PNG images from PNG, JPG, and WebP uploads.

## Website
- Homepage: https://free-ai-background-remover.telephonenumber-3574355.workers.dev/
- Sitemap: https://free-ai-background-remover.telephonenumber-3574355.workers.dev/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://free-ai-background-remover.telephonenumber-3574355.workers.dev/robots.txt

## What the tool does
- Removes image backgrounds and exports transparent PNG files.
- Supports PNG, JPEG, and WebP input files up to 15 MB.
- Offers Fast and High detail browser-AI model options.
- Tries Cloudflare server-side image segmentation first, then uses browser-based AI as a fallback when server processing is unavailable.

## Privacy and processing
When Cloudflare server processing is available, the selected image is sent to Cloudflare for processing. If server processing is unavailable, the browser-based fallback processes the image locally. The Worker does not store uploaded source or result images.

## Usage
1. Open the homepage.
2. Choose or drop a PNG, JPG, or WebP image (maximum 15 MB).
3. Select the desired AI quality.
4. Choose “Remove background”.
5. Download the transparent PNG result.

## Important notes
- The first browser-AI run may take longer because model assets need to download.
- Results depend on image quality, subject/background contrast, network conditions, and device capabilities.
- The website currently provides a single-page background-removal tool; there are no separate editorial or documentation sections.
